benefits.title: Nitrogen and yield carry-over from legumes
benefits.text: Legume-to-next-crop sequences in this plan (pigeonpea then maize) are the pattern that rotation studies link to higher yield in the following crop: 23% on average for legume pre-crops versus 16% for non-legumes in 3,663 field comparisons worldwide.
conditions: Average of many trials, not a forecast for your field; roughly one trial in four showed no gain or a loss.
The gain shrinks where nitrogen fertiliser use is high.
